arStrings.szText: Mephisto has gotten the upper hand, but all is not lost. In her writings, Neyrelle said that the Oracle is the key to finding a way to defeat the Lord of Hatred for good. Lorath and I must seek her out on the island of Philios.

Lorath came to Queen Adreona as a hero, and Mephisto made him into a villain. Now the whole of Temis thinks the old Horadrim is a killer. Mephisto has given him "mercy" but it is only a means to torment Lorath. I must help him through this ordeal.
